has: Person-centred personal care (washing, dressing, toileting, continence)
Mental health awareness and emotional support
Safe moving and handling (hoists, slide sheets)
Observations, food and fluid charts, record keeping
doesNotYetHave: NVQ / Diploma in Health and Social Care
skillsTruth.rule: Never claim a qualification she does not hold. She DOES hold the Care Certificate and a current enhanced DBS. Entry HCA/care roles that say 'no experience necessary / full training' remain strong fits.

honesty.rightToWork: Currently authorised to work in the UK on a Student visa (with student work-hour limits). Requires Health and Care Worker visa sponsorship for full-time ongoing employment.
honesty.doNotFabricate: Do not invent employers, dates, qualifications or achievements. Achievements are honest descriptions of real duties with honest scope, never invented metrics.
honesty.coverLetterRule: Cover letters and supporting statements = fit for the role + genuine interest + compassion ONLY. No visa/sponsorship/CoS/salary/notice. (L13)
honesty.voiceRule: Human voice. No em-dashes. No AI-tell words. Plain, warm, specific.

cadence.perCompany90Day: One CV lane per company per 90 days; never two CVs to the same employer (L7).
cadence.preferDirectEmployers: Prefer CQC-registered care providers and NHS trusts over generic staffing agencies.

doNotApply: Roles that explicitly state no visa sponsorship or must already have unrestricted right to work
Generic recruitment agencies that are not the sponsoring employer unless they are a CQC-registered care provider acting as direct employer
Roles requiring a UK nursing or clinical registration she does not hold (RGN/RMN)
Roles requiring a driving licence or own car if she cannot meet it, mainly domiciliary
Senior or registered-manager roles requiring NVQ Level 3 or 5 she does not hold
